rules: this ANT Colony owns its lib, content, data, admission, refusal, contracts, language maps, semiotes, and evidence
a semiote acts only through a colony contract and never acquires the customer's admission authority
a parse is a candidate reading and never a declaration of speaker intent
translation preserves source and target frames together with every explicit non-correspondence
legacy source is admitted for internal operation only until its redistribution license is decided
SHP is an optional projection and cannot gate the JSON parsing contract
